templates.pattern: In a class of [N] students, [P1] ranks [A]th from the top. What is [P1]'s rank from the bottom?
templates.explanation: Rank from bottom = Total students - Rank from top + 1 = [N]-[A]+1

templates.pattern: [P1] ranks [A]th from the top and [B]th from the bottom in a row. How many students are in the row?
templates.explanation: Total students = Rank from top + Rank from bottom - 1 = [A]+[B]-1

templates.pattern: In a queue of [N] persons, [P1] is [A]th from the front. How many persons are behind [P1]?
templates.explanation: Persons behind = Total - Position from front = [N]-[A]

templates.pattern: [P1] is [A]th from the left in a row of [N] persons. [P2] is [B]th from the right. How many persons are between them?
templates.explanation: Persons between = N - A - B = [N]-[A]-[B] (when [P1] is left of [P2])

templates.pattern: A train departs at [HH]:[MM]. It takes [DUR] minutes to reach the destination. At what time does it arrive?
templates.explanation: Arrival = Departure + Duration. Departure=[HH]:[MM], Duration=[DUR] min

templates.pattern: Five students [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4],[P5] are ranked 1 to 5. [P3] ranks higher than [P1]. [P2] ranks lower than [P4]. [P5] ranks 1st. [P1] ranks 3rd. What is [P3]'s rank?
templates.explanation: [P5]=1st, [P1]=3rd. [P3] ranks higher than [P1] → [P3]=2nd. [P4]=4th, [P2]=5th

templates.pattern: [P1] started walking at [HH]:[MM] and walked for [DUR] minutes. At what time did [P1] stop?
templates.explanation: Stop time = Start + Duration = [HH]:[MM] + [DUR] minutes

templates.pattern: In a class, [P1] is [A]th from top. [P2] is [B] ranks below [P1]. What is [P2]'s rank from top?
templates.explanation: [P2] rank from top = [P1] rank + B = [A]+[B]

templates.pattern: An event started on [DAY1] and lasted [DAYS] days (including start day). On which day did it end?
templates.explanation: End day = Start day + (DAYS-1) days forward

templates.pattern: In a competition, [P1] finished [A] places ahead of [P2]. [P2] finished [B]th. What position did [P1] finish?
templates.explanation: [P1] position = [P2] position - A = [B]-[A]

templates.pattern: [P1] takes [T1] minutes to complete a task. [P2] takes [T2] minutes. They start together. How many minutes before [P2] does [P1] finish?
templates.explanation: Difference = T2 - T1 = [T2]-[T1] minutes

templates.pattern: Today is [DAY]. What day will it be after [N] days?
templates.explanation: Move [N] days forward from [DAY]. [N] mod 7 = [N%7] extra days

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from the front and [P2] is [A]th from the back. How many students are between them?
templates.explanation: Between them = N - 2*A = [N] - 2*[A] (when they are not the same person)

templates.pattern: [P1] was born in [YEAR]. His age this year ([CY]) is [AGE]. In how many years will [P1] be [TARGET] years old?
templates.explanation: Years from now = Target age - Current age = [TARGET]-[AGE]

templates.pattern: A bus leaves every [INT] minutes. Last bus left at [HH]:[MM]. When will the next bus leave?
templates.explanation: Next bus = Last bus time + Interval = [HH]:[MM] + [INT] minutes

templates.pattern: In a class of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from top in Maths and [B]th from top in Science. What is the minimum possible number of students who rank above [P1] in both subjects?
templates.explanation: Minimum who rank above in BOTH = min(A,B)-1 = min([A],[B])-1

templates.pattern: [P1] completed a task in [T1] hours starting at [SH]:[SM]. [P2] started [D] hours later. [P2] also takes [T1] hours. Who finishes first?
templates.explanation: [P1] finishes at SH+T1. [P2] starts D hours later, finishes at SH+D+T1. [P1] finishes D hours earlier

templates.pattern: In a row, [P1] is [A]th from left. After [K] new students join to the left of [P1], what is [P1]'s new rank from the left?
templates.explanation: New rank from left = Old rank + New students added to left = [A]+[K]

templates.pattern: A meeting was scheduled at [SH]:[SM]. It started [LATE] minutes late and lasted [DUR] minutes. At what time did it end?
templates.explanation: End time = Scheduled time + Late start + Duration = [SH]:[SM] + [LATE] + [DUR] mins

templates.pattern: Five runners finished a race. [P1] finished before [P3] but after [P2]. [P4] finished last. [P5] finished just before [P4]. In what position did [P1] finish?
templates.explanation: Order: [P2]-?-[P1]-[P3]-[P5]-[P4]. [P1]=3rd position

templates.pattern: [P1] was [A] years old [K] years ago. How old will [P1] be [M] years from now?
templates.explanation: Current age = A+K. Future age = A+K+M = [A]+[K]+[M]

templates.pattern: In a class of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from top. [P2] is [B]th from bottom. If [P1] and [P2] are the same person, how many students are in the class?
templates.explanation: Total = Rank from top + Rank from bottom - 1 = [A]+[B]-1

templates.pattern: A clock shows [HH]:[MM]. After [MIN] minutes, what time will the clock show?
templates.explanation: New time = [HH]:[MM] + [MIN] minutes

templates.pattern: In a merit list of [N] students, [P1] is ranked [A]th. [K] students who scored higher than [P1] are disqualified. What is [P1]'s new rank?
templates.explanation: New rank = Old rank - Disqualified students above = [A]-[K]

templates.pattern: [P1] joined office at [SH]:[SM] AM. Worked for [WH] hours with a [BRK] minute lunch break. At what time did [P1] leave?
templates.explanation: Leave time = Join time + Work hours + Break = [SH]:[SM] + [WH]hrs + [BRK]min
